title: VerificationBundle
description: Everything needed to check one witness statement with no network: the statement, its evidence manifest, the key list as read, and the exact mapping bytes. Written by `trooth verify --save-bundle`; read by `trooth verify --bundle` and the SDKs. A bundle is only as fresh as its key list.

created_at.description: When the bundle was written. An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, as written by Trooth (for example 2026-10-06T20:00:44.820Z).

domain.description: The domain the bundle was saved for. A reader may ask about another; a statement for a different domain is a mismatch.

statement.description: The signed envelope, exactly as published.

manifest.description: The evidence manifest, or null when none was saved.

keys.description: The key list as read when the bundle was written.

mapping.description: The exact mapping bytes, or null when none were saved.

log.description: What the witness statement log answered when the bundle was written: the log key used, the receipt or null, and every correction. Absent in a bundle written before the log, or when the log was not read.

BundleLog.title: BundleLog
BundleLog.description: The log answer, carried so the log part can be checked offline too.

vkey.description: The log verifier key the receipt was checked against, as a signed-note key (name+hash+key). A pinned key, when the checker has one, replaces it.

receipt.description: The receipt for the statement, or null when the log held no entry for it.

corrections.description: Every logged correction naming this statement, each with its own receipt.

LoggedCorrection.title: LoggedCorrection
LoggedCorrection.description: A correction envelope and its receipt.

statement.description: The correction envelope: its payload is a trooth.correction.v1 document in RFC 8785 bytes.

keys.description: The keys array of the key list.

list_read_at.description: When the key list was read. An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, as written by Trooth (for example 2026-10-06T20:00:44.820Z).

source.description: Where it was read from: a URL or a file path.

BundleMapping.title: BundleMapping
BundleMapping.description: The mapping document, byte for byte.

url.description: Where the bytes were read from.

digest.description: The digest of the carried bytes, for display. A checker hashes the bytes itself and compares with the signed digest.

bytes_base64.description: The exact mapping bytes, standard base64.
